shots.purpose: Hook: car at start, speedo shows 2 m/s; question caption on screen.
Compressed preview of the whole journey; speedo climbs 2->14; intrigue, no numbers taught yet.
Freeze on finish + goal card: answer comes two ways by lesson end.
Contrast: uniform motion, constant speedo, equal spacing ticks; v=s/t caption.
Speedometer close-up: four equal +3 ticks; the meaning of a=3 made visible.
a-vector appears; definition a=dv/dt and unit caption fixed on screen.
Ox axis along motion; plus-sign rule; B1 recap line.
Formula assembles in parts: start v0 + gain a*t; each part colour-coded.
Numeric substitution 2+3*4=14; digits drop into the coloured slots.
Unit check: (m/s^2)*s -> m/s; result stamped.
Displacement arrow start->finish; direction guard stated before formula.
Formula s=v0t+at^2/2; two terms in two colours (blue cruise + red boost).
Bars v0*T and a*T^2/2 grow with the same T; totals 8+24=32; car replays x(T) underneath.
Axes appear; line v=2+3t draws itself with tracer dot (T,v(T)).
Slope triangle dv/dt on the line; dv=12, dt=4 -> a=3; caption slope=a.
Rule restated and frozen: slope of v-t graph equals acceleration.
Trapezoid fills under the curve in sync with car replay x(T); area counter runs to 32.
Green check stamp: area 32 matches formula 32; two ways, one answer.
Pause-task condition card; data only, no solution visible.
Pause card with icon; viewer solves alone.
Short solution 0*5+2*25/2=25 revealed after the pause.
Trap E1 crossed out: 14*4=56 with red X; average hint appears.
Trap E2 defused: slope arrow (red) vs area fill (green) side by side.
Formula triptych cheat-sheet + ENT bridge line; lesson closes.

colors.a: RED: acceleration vector, slope triangle, a-slots in formulas
colors.area: GREEN fill 0.35 opacity: area under v-t = displacement
colors.car: YELLOW body: the moving car, same drawing all blocks
colors.s: GREEN: displacement arrow, s-slots, area counter
colors.t: GRAY-BLUE: time values and dt segments
colors.v: BLUE: velocity arrow, speedo needle, v-slots, v-t curve
colors.wrong: RED X + strikethrough: errors only; never co-present with the a-vector in one frame

layout.captions: top band, unicode Text (subscripts 0/2, delta, middot), no LaTeX
layout.split: world view (left) + graph view (right) share one clock T in animated shots

notation.axis: Ox directed along the motion; forward projections take +

physics.rule: Every animated quantity is a function of one monotonic clock T per shot (car x(T), speedo v(T), graph dot (T,v(T)), area s(T)). Slow motion scales dT/dt_screen only; the model x(t),v(t) never changes.
